# Archival Dispatch: 16 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Heartbeat Theatre, Ellery Queen Minute Mysteries, and The Bob Crosby Show

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Heartbeat Theatre, Ellery Queen, Bob Crosby, C.P. MacGregor, Salvation Army, Dixieland Jazz, Original Filenames

## Batch 16 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 16 resolves 16 classic radio broadcasts and mystery dramas: 6 syndicated Hollywood productions of C.P. MacGregor's ***Heartbeat Theatre*** (produced for The Salvation Army), 7 syndicated radio detective cases from ***Ellery Queen's Minute Mysteries*** (1965 master syndication series), and 3 Marine Corps recruitment broadcasts of ***The Bob Crosby Show*** (featuring Bob Crosby and his Bob Cats with guest Eileen Barton).

---
